messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: multiple Evicted events seen on nodes in namespace=redwood-prod due to ephemeral-storage pressure. Please triage. thread:1952345678

Eve: I'm seeing model-cache pods restarting repeatedly, a few serve runtimes OOMKilled too. Dropping availability for some routes.

Anita: logs show repeated failures: 'write /tmp/modelcache/shard-9: no space left on device' followed by container restarts. Kubelet eviction logs right after.

Mike: also spotted CUDA allocation failures in serve-runtime just before restart: 'CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY while allocating 1.1 GiB'. Looks like cache churn plus large in-memory allocations.

oncall-bot: paging @oncall-microservices (Eve) and @oncall-infra (Anita) :pager: please ack and join the thread.

Eve: acked. Priorities: 1) stop customer impact, 2) stabilize pods, 3) free node disk.

James: impact summary: 5xx rate up ~20% for text-gen over last 10m; a handful of customers report failing requests.

Sarah: flagging enterprise customer "acme-corp" — their integration shows ~25% failure. CS needs heads-up.

Anita: hypothesis: modelcache writes to emptyDir on the container root (shared with /tmp) and debug-level logs plus rotated dumps are consuming ephemeral disk. Kubelet eviction threshold triggered.

Mike: node FS check: /var/lib/kubelet/pods/*/volumes/*/emptyDir at 94-98%. dmesg shows ext4 allocation warnings before OOMs.

Eve: mitigations proposed: cordon affected nodes, reduce model cache footprint, disable debug log dumps, restart affected deployments, and clean up orphaned cache files. Also consider temporary PVC mount for cache. Which to do now?

Anita: cordon nodes immediately to avoid additional pods landing there. Simultaneously patch modelcache config to set CACHE_LIMIT=8GB and LOG_LEVEL=info, then trigger rolling restart.

Mike: creating quick k8s patch now. Patch snippet:```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: model-cache-v2
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: model-cache
        env:
        - name: CACHE_LIMIT_BYTES
          value: "8589934592"
        - name: DEBUG_LOGS
          value: "false"
```

oncall-bot: system: cordon executed on node ip-10-0-47-9 by anita at 1952345780

Anita: node cordoned. applying deployment patch and triggering rollout restart for model-cache-v2.

Eve: also applying a logging config override to prevent debug dumps across prod: updating configmap logging-global -> level: info.

Sarah: can we throttle preloads? acme-corp does aggressive prewarm; reduce prewarm threads to limit churn.

Mike: updated deployment to set PREWARM_WORKERS=1 and launched rollout. Rollout: 1/3 updated -> 3/3 available in progress.

James: monitoring: eviction events dropping after restarts, 5xx rate decreasing after ~7 minutes.

Mike: manual cleanup command I ran on one node to free space:```bash
kubectl debug node/ip-10-0-47-9 -it --image=busybox -- chroot /host sh -c 'rm -rf /var/lib/kubelet/pods/*/volumes/*/emptyDir/*/modelcache-*; sync'
``` freed ~110GB on that node. Use with care.

Anita: after cleanup disk usage on node fell to ~60% and kubelet stopped evicting pods. model-cache replicas stabilized.

Eve: longer-term actions: 1) migrate model cache to PVC-backed storage; 2) lower kubelet eviction thresholds / add pre-alert at 80% usage; 3) add log retention policy (auto-clean ≥24h); 4) surface emptyDir usage metrics per pod in Grafana.

Sarah: CS notified and drafting message to acme-corp explaining root cause, mitigation steps, and ETA for permanent fix.

ops-bot: follow-up runbook created: runbook/1952345678-emptydir-saturation.md (internal)

Anita: adding notes to incident ticket: ensure default logging level safe for prod, make prewarm limits configurable per customer, and require PVC for large caches.

James: follow-up: metrics returned to baseline, no new evictions for 30 minutes. Will keep monitoring. Marking incident as resolved pending postmortem. :white_check_mark:

Eve: thanks all. If anyone sees leftover CUDA OOMs, ping me directly.

oncall-bot: incident severity S2 - assigned to infra+runtime. Handoff to next oncall at 1952346000.

Eve: closing notes: postmortem ticket created and owners assigned.

oncall-bot: incident thread closed by eve at 1952346038
